C-ADAPTIVE-ACTION-CENTER-V2.IntentSummary: Supersede the unintegrated first attempt and deliver one stable adaptive + Добавить entry point and universal immutable document router by composing existing feature launchers, existing worker classifiers/materializers and a non-destructive protocol-to-meeting merge, with rank-only learning, deterministic degraded fallback and browser verification delegated to the normal project CI.

T-001.Title: kafedra-flow-intake: freeze the universal action and document routing state machine

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The flow starts with immediate static actions, accepts a file before any type question, preserves documentId after upload, distinguishes processing, exact destination, ambiguous review and failed/degraded states, and never requires a second upload.
Plan, meeting/protocol, directive, science and unknown-document outcomes have explicit next screens; one bad row or conflicting meeting fact does not block other safe results.

T-002.Title: kafedra-design: define one stable Action Center shell for desktop and mobile

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Desktop and mobile use the same action hierarchy: fixed title/search-upload region, exactly three fixed recommendation slots, fixed groups and stable controls; keyboard focus, Escape close, focus restoration and drop-zone affordance are explicit.
Context changes content inside reserved regions rather than moving controls, and local contextual shortcuts remain available outside the global center.

T-003.Title: kafedra-motion: specify restrained continuity for Action Center transitions and upload progress

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Routine open/close and content transitions use short interruption-safe opacity/transform continuity without bounce or decorative delay; upload state changes remain readable in static frames.
prefers-reduced-motion removes spatial transitions while preserving focus order, progress text, destination state and all controls on desktop and mobile.

T-004.Title: kafedra-data: preserve provenance, idempotency and rank-only preference safety

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No migration is added; existing document versions, extraction runs, review items, meeting/agenda evidence and ui_choice_preferences remain the only durable stores used by this change.
action.center.action validates only known action IDs, records only successful explicit user launches and automatic document routing never records a learned action.
Protocol reuse keeps existing non-empty facts authoritative, associates new evidence with the incoming document version and emits idempotent review items for conflicts or ambiguous matches.

T-005.Title: kafedra-feature: implement safe protocol reuse and exact processing destination identity

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: persistProtocol returns the exact meeting ID for both create and safe-reuse paths; same source version is idempotent; exact unique number/date matching may reuse a meeting; ambiguous matching never overwrites an existing meeting.

Missing compatible meeting and agenda fields are filled or inserted only when non-conflicting; normalized duplicate agenda items are not duplicated; conflicts are preserved as review items with incoming document evidence.
The persisted protocol meeting ID is included in extraction result_json so a client can route a merged protocol to the exact existing meeting without a second API or parser.

T-006.Title: kafedra-feature: implement the extensible Action Registry, adaptive shell and universal immutable upload router

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: + Добавить, Ctrl/Cmd+N and calendar-day plus enter the same center; day context is carried into task/event creation and outranks learned ranking.
Existing feature modules register adapters for their real launchers; the Action Center does not duplicate domain forms and future actions can register without editing a central business-logic switch.

File upload uses normal /api/documents immutable intake, polls only the accepted documentId, derives exact destination from the completed extraction result, opens that exact plan/meeting/directive/science target, and falls back to the document/review surface for unknown or ambiguous results.
Recommendation slots rank available actions lexicographically by explicit context and domain relevance before action.center.action frequency; preference failure leaves the static catalog usable.
Desktop, mobile and prefers-reduced-motion behavior follows T-002/T-003 with no new runtime dependency; dedicated Playwright coverage is mandatory in the normal browser CI before merge.

T-007.Title: kafedra-design-audit: independently audit the implemented Action Center and document continuity

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The audit returns PASS, REVISE or BLOCK after inspecting hierarchy, stable geometry, document drop/progress/destination continuity, interruption, static state, keyboard/focus, desktop/mobile equivalence, prefers-reduced-motion and consistency with adjacent inspectors/forms.

T-008.Title: kafedra-tests: verify ranking, routing, meeting merge, degraded mode and responsive interaction

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit/integration tests prove domain context outranks frequency, invalid action preference values fail closed, same-source and exact-meeting protocol reuse are idempotent, conflicts remain non-destructive, and route-after-upload uses the exact processing result.

Project/browser CI must run tests/browser/action-center.spec.mjs on desktop and mobile and include prefers-reduced-motion coverage for Add, calendar-date creation, generic file upload, exact destination and generic-document fallback; recommendation failure must not block static actions.

T-009.Title: kafedra-release: prove no schema, runtime dependency or offline regression

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Version and schema remain unchanged, no dependency is added, existing backup/restore behavior is unaffected, and full project, browser, release, offline and GRACE gates remain mandatory on one unchanged PR head before squash merge.
